items.text: FTSE MIB Closes Higher — The FTSE MIB rose 1% to 51,969 on Wednesday, amid gains across sectors. Sovereign yields declined as the surge in crude prices eased, while markets awaited the Fed’s monetary policy decision after the close, with a rate hike widely expected. Although higher rates could weigh on credit demand, financials outperformed in Milan. Consob opened an investigation into Intesa’s (0.6%) bid for MPS (-0.1%). Although Intesa had agreed to dispose of half of MPS’s branches, preliminary checks by the authorities indicated that the deal could still raise competition concerns regardless of the divestment. Tech stock STMicroelectronics advanced 2%, while defense stocks Leonardo (1%) and Avio (0.4%) outperformed, driven by renewed signs of the need to rebuild Western arsenals. Utilities also extended recent gains, led by A2A (2%). Stellantis dropped 3.3%, while Prime Minister Meloni announced the abolition of road tax for small and medium-sized vehicles.

【國有控股上市公司年內披露1239單併購計劃】今年以來，央企、地方國企加快推進國有經濟佈局最佳化和結構調整。 同花順iFinD資料顯示，以首次公告日計，剔除交易失敗案例，今年以來截至9月16日，A股國有控股上市公司（包括央企國資控股、省屬國資控股、地市國資控股及其他國有企業）已披露1239單併購計劃。其中，18單涉及重大資產收購/出讓/置換。“今年國企重組整合的一個明顯變化是產業邏輯更強，且資本市場在這一輪國有經濟佈局最佳化和結構調整過程中，作用愈發突出。”在中泰證券首席策略分析師徐馳看來，今年國企重組的主線比較清晰：傳統行業裡，能源、汽車、化工等領域更強調同類資產集中，透過專業化整合提高行業集中度和運營效率；戰略性新興產業領域，半導體、新材料、高階裝備、新能源等方向的併購更多圍繞技術、產能和產業鏈短板展開。(證券日報)
